title: Boosting Deepresearch and LongContext Ability with Self-Generated Deepresearch Rollouts Traces
abstract: arXiv:2609.20844v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deepresearch (DR) agents interact with real-world web environments through multi-turn search and visit, causing their contexts to grow rapidly over time. We observe that, even after DR Agentic Reinforcement Learning (DR-RL), 61.6% of the model's remaining prediction errors can still be attributed to insufficient long-context understanding, including longcontext hallucination and failures in cross-document evidence integration. It motivates us to further break the bottleneck of DR-RL by strengthening the model's long-context ability. However, effective LongContext training requires more than simply increasing context length. To bridge the data gap, we propose `DR Rollouts to LongContext-QA (DR-to-Long)'. The method repurposes DR-RL trajectories, which naturally contain search histories, visited webpages, evidence snippets, and final-answer supervision. translated_title: 利用自生成的深度研究轨迹提升深度研究与长上下文能力
translated_abstract: 深度研究代理通过多轮搜索和访问与真实世界的网络环境进行交互，导致其上下文随时间快速增长。我们观察到，即使经过深度研究智能体强化学习（DR-RL）之后，模型剩余预测误差中仍有61.6%可归因于长上下文理解能力不足，包括长上下文幻觉和跨文档证据整合失败。这促使我们通过增强模型的长上下文能力来进一步突破DR-RL的瓶颈。然而，有效的长上下文训练不仅仅是简单地增加上下文长度。为了弥合数据差距，我们提出了“DR Rollouts to LongContext-QA（DR-to-Long）”方法。该方法重新利用DR-RL轨迹，这些轨迹天然包含搜索历史、访问过的网页、证据片段和最终答案监督信息，然后将每个轨迹中的紧凑片段和网页摘要替换为……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出DR-to-Long方法，将深度研究强化学习自生成的轨迹（含搜索历史、网页、证据片段）转化为长上下文问答训练数据，以提升模型长上下文能力并突破DR-RL的性能瓶颈。
en_tdlr: Proposes DR-to-Long, which repurposes self-generated Deepresearch RL rollout traces (containing search histories, webpages, and evidence snippets) into LongContext-QA training data to boost long-context ability and break through the DR-RL performance bottleneck.
